overview: Before the afternoon you had your roll as Chorus and as the Prince. You marked it the third time to a yard, and you did not change a line. You noted Saturday as the fourth, if the bill holds.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the unchanged roll and went on.

assets.name: Romeo and Juliet
assets.disposition: Went on as Chorus and Prince, the third time

summary: Went on as Chorus and Prince, the third time
